تستفرغوا (form X)
# تَسْتَفْرِغُوا (tastafriḡū) /tas.taf.ri.ɣuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
# تُسْتَفْرَغُوا (tustafraḡū) /tus.taf.ra.ɣuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
